title: Cursor live apps, Copilot in Xcode, Claude Code auto mode
summary: In short: [Build Live Apps in Cursor](https://cursor.com/changelog/build-live-apps) (all paid plans with cloud agents enabled): A cloud agent builds the web app and sets up hosting, auth behind Cursor SSO and, if needed, a Postgres database; security checks must pass before you publish it on a domain you pick; [GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-04-github-copilot-is-now-available-in-xcodes-coding-assistant/) (public preview, starting with Xcode 27.3 beta): Copilot runs inside Xcode's built-in coding assistant (set it up in Xcode > Settings > Intelligence). It works on all Copilot plans, and the GitHub Copilot for Xcode extension is still a separate option; [Claude Code v2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319): With telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways, auto mode now asks about or denies calls the server can't check and doesn't fall back to the built-in classifier; `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` keeps the classifier. Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged

items.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.300
items.text: Task read status now syncs with supported hosts, helping clear stale unread indicators across devices.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.317
items.text: Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network

items.title: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
items.text: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows bring your own key (BYOK) usage across GitHub Copilot, so you can separate it from Copilot-hosted model usage.

items.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
items.text: You can now delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results with GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Air.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.318
items.text: Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)

items.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
items.text: You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant, bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow.

items.title: Build Live Apps in Cursor
items.text: Describe what you want to create and Cursor will handle the rest: build the app, set up a database, configure auth, and deploy it.

items.title: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
items.text: The enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now show what happens to Copilot code review feedback.

items.title: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
items.text: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows which users are missing client telemetry or are running IDE or extension versions below the usage metrics minimums.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.319
items.text: Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier

items.title: Codex 0.167.0
items.text: Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results.

items.title: Voice Chat with Agents
items.text: You can now talk with your agents in a realtime voice call.

items.title: Copilot code review: API management and review overview updates
items.text: You can now manage GitHub Copilot code review settings through the REST and GraphQL APIs, from enterprise policy down to individual repositories.

items.title: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
items.text: The Agent adoption chart in the Copilot impact dashboard now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, so you can see engagement across nine Copilot experiences.

items.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
items.text: Give Copilot guidance on which tool requests to approve without asking you. Personal instructions for assisted approval are opt-in and apply to local sessions.

items.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available and more
items.text: Investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes, and open pull requests—all without leaving your conversation.
